_about: Hand-assigned treatment labels for 40 citation edges of index/citations.jsonl, read by `python -m nyaya.authority.treatment audit` and scripts/treatment_audit.py. Sampled 10 per predicted label with random.Random(358). Each label is my reading of the sentence window. Annotator: Rakshit (M1).
_keys: src|dst|cite_string|p<para_id>|sha1(window)[:10]. Not the line number: Member 2 rebuilds citations.jsonl when he improves extraction (70,776 -> 76,118 edges in one rebuild), and src|dst|cite alone is not unique because he emits one edge per evidence window. The window fingerprint makes the key unique and makes a gold entry self-invalidating when its evidence changes, which is right: the hand label judged that window. The audit reports any vanished key loudly instead of shrinking the denominator.

_notes.13297|-1|(1990) 1 SCC 12|p23|85fcb28606: The cue 'overruled' is 134 characters away and its object is Rangachari, a different case: 'In Indra Sawhney, this Court overruled its earlier judgment in General Manager, Southern Railway v. Rangachari'. The cited judgment is only mentioned.
_notes.3893|4680|[1972] 1 S.C.R. 896|p1|e9b54b7: 'View contra expressed in ... D. Vaid v. State of Punjab [1972] 1 S.C.R. 896 ... not followed' - a not-followed contrary view, which is the overruled bucket.
_notes.6747|4437|(1971] 3 SCR 522|p11|ebaf19c3f: The overruling cue sits inside counsel's submission ('It was pointed out by Mr. Rao, however, that such a view seems to have been taken in two other decisions'), not in the Court's own holding.
_notes.12977|-1|(2008) 8 SCC 300|p81|040bfc13b4: Borderline: the cited case is the one doing the reiterating, but the Court is adopting its reasoning, so 'followed' is the fair reading.
_notes.5363|4093|[1970] 2 SCR 854|p40|f7fe8ed5f: 'relied upon' is 263 characters away, inside an enumerated list of legal propositions, and is not this citation's disposition. The followed label is uncapped by distance on purpose - headnote lists share one disposition - and this is the price of that choice.

limitation_case.why: Negation scope is approximated by a character window (NEGATION_WINDOW_CHARS = 80) instead of a syntactic parse. Here 'could not be continued by his legal representatives' is part of the proposition the cited case held, not a negation of the 'overruled' that follows it. The window sees 'not' 24 characters before the cue and suppresses a real overruling.
limitation_case.video_beat: limitation-live: run `python -m nyaya.authority.treatment audit --verbose` for the gold-vs-predicted table, then `explain --edge <n>` and read the sentence aloud
limitation_case.note: The edge index moves when Member 2 rebuilds citations.jsonl; find it with `python -m nyaya.authority.treatment sample --label mentioned` or grep the cite_string.
